definitions.explanation: A stamp sold by the government and stuck on documents to pay a tax or fee. Usually {収入印紙|しゅうにゅういんし}.

examples.japanese: {収入印紙|しゅうにゅういんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{印紙|いんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧。
examples.english: To put a revenue stamp on the contract.

examples.japanese: ⟦パスポート→パスポート：00341_pasupooto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}→申請：04207_shinsei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{印紙|いんし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Applying for a passport requires revenue stamps to pay the fee.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {収入印紙|しゅうにゅういんし}: revenue stamp (the full name)
- {印紙|いんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧: to affix a stamp
- {印紙税|いんしぜい}: stamp duty

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Contracts and receipts above a set amount need a stamp. Stamps are sold at post offices and at many convenience stores.
